candidate_negotiation_playbook.evidence: AERO India 2025 stall operations lead, Puma India brand activation runner, 300+ on-ground deployments.
candidate_negotiation_playbook.recruiter_objection: 'Freshers require 3-6 months of training before handling independent operations.'
candidate_negotiation_playbook.negotiation_counter: Present execution portfolio proving zero ramp-up time. Request immediate placement in high-visibility Tier-1 account teams with an entry band at the 80th-90th percentile.
candidate_negotiation_playbook.target_delta: +10% to +15% over standard fresher grid (e.g. INR 7.5L vs 6.5L)

candidate_negotiation_playbook.evidence: 48-hour proposal velocity closed commercial revenue in Commercial Operations in Bangalore.
candidate_negotiation_playbook.recruiter_objection: 'Undergraduate B2B sales roles start at fixed INR 5.5 LPA base.'
candidate_negotiation_playbook.negotiation_counter: Show actual invoice pipeline and lead conversion rate from Pencil Mark. Argue that proven revenue closure derisks quota attainment. Negotiate for either a higher fixed base (INR 6.5L+) or accelerated 6-month promotion review clause.
candidate_negotiation_playbook.target_delta: +15% to +20% base increase or INR 1L sign-on bonus

candidate_negotiation_playbook.evidence: Achieved Tier-1 vendor rate structuring and SLA governance through workflow standard operating procedures and vendor negotiations.
candidate_negotiation_playbook.recruiter_objection: 'Operations analyst bands are non-negotiable for campus hires.'
candidate_negotiation_playbook.negotiation_counter: Demonstrate Lean / Six-Sigma problem solving methodology. Request a performance milestone clause in offer letter: if process optimization metrics meet top-box rating in Q2, trigger an automatic 15% retention appraisal.
candidate_negotiation_playbook.target_delta: Guaranteed 6-month appraisal fast-track in offer letter

candidate_negotiation_playbook.evidence: Academic distinction in BBA International Business, mastery of Incoterms 2020, HS classifications, and UCP 600 Letter of Credit rules.
candidate_negotiation_playbook.negotiation_counter: Highlight that incorrect HS codes or LC discrepancies cost logistics firms thousands of dollars in port demurrage and customs fines. Aditya's verified domain precision prevents compliance penalties on day one.
candidate_negotiation_playbook.target_delta: +10% premium in GCC / Logistics specialists like Maersk, DHL, Boeing

candidate_negotiation_playbook.evidence: Active pipeline across 3,000 requisitions and multiple shortlist tracks in FinTech, GCCs, and Big 4.
candidate_negotiation_playbook.negotiation_counter: Acknowledge culture fit with genuine enthusiasm, while politely signaling parallel active interview tracks in Tier-1 GCCs. Ask for compensation alignment to the upper tier of the band to enable immediate acceptance.
candidate_negotiation_playbook.target_delta: Conversion of variable promise into fixed guaranteed base

Upgraded living: shared 2BHK in HSR/Koramangala or luxury single PG, weekend dining, active gym membership, healthy INR 15k+ monthly investment.
High comfort: Independent 1BHK or premium 2BHK master bedroom, annual vacation fund, high consumer electronics budget, INR 20k+ mutual fund SIPs.
Top tier fresh graduate lifestyle: Gated society living, cab commutes, generous leisure, international travel buffer, INR 25k+ monthly wealth creation.
